summary: First test run. Backend: 15/15 tests PASSED (100%). Frontend: all core flows working on 390x844 mobile viewport — craving input + submit returns 6 restaurant cards, save button triggers toast and persists to Saved tab, budget toggle cycles ($, $$, Any $), surprise-me button present, mic FAB opens voice sheet which cancels cleanly, travel phrase 'I'm travelling to Rome next Friday hungry for lunch' correctly navigates to /trip/[id] with Rome lunch restaurants, trip detail renders calendar buttons + delete + hero.
action_items: Note testID naming mismatches vs the review request (functionality works, only names differ): voice sheet cancel testID is 'voice-cancel-button' (not 'voice-cancel'); trip detail calendar buttons are 'trip-add-device-calendar-button' and 'trip-add-google-calendar-button' (not 'trip-device-calendar-button' / 'trip-google-calendar-button'). Either keep as-is or rename to match the spec — your call.

Trips tab form creation (POST /api/trips) and Saved-tab history-chip tap-to-run-query flows were not end-to-end exercised in UI due to bottom-tab visibility after navigating into trip detail; backend endpoints are verified green and the Trips form was confirmed rendered with correct testIDs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes Mongo _id via BaseDocument.out() + aliased id. Good.
Favorite add is idempotent on restaurant.name (returns existing). Good.
LLM call uses model 'gpt-5.5' which responded correctly for all prompts in ~5-10s.
Transcribe endpoint correctly short-circuits with empty text for <2KB audio (verified).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (core flows all green; a couple of secondary tap-through flows not exercised but underlying APIs green)

seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed trips and favorites and clean them up (delete) within the same run. Also leaves behind one 'pizza' craving history row and the trip created by the UI travel-phrase test; not harmful.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL env var in frontend is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Mobile viewport 390x844. LLM calls take 5-15s; use >=60s wait_for_selector for restaurant-card-0 after submitting craving. Trip detail buttons use 'trip-add-device-calendar-button' / 'trip-add-google-calendar-button'. Voice cancel is 'voice-cancel-button'.
